context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 80 validated Survey Archive (manual + auto) and Meeting Templates with Custom Recurring Schedule. Key behaviors: (1) POST /api/surveys/{id}/archive sets status='archived', archived_at, archived_by=user_id. (2) POST /api/surveys/{id}/restore sets status='published', clears archived_at. (3) POST /api/surveys/archive/run {grace_days:14} auto-archives expired surveys with archived_by='system'. (4) GET /api/surveys (no status) excludes archived, GET /api/surveys?status=archived returns only archived. (5) GET /api/surveys/pending-count excludes archived. (6) POST /api/templates with recurring=true, recurring_pattern='custom', recurring_schedule=[{weekday,start_time,end_time}], recurring_weeks, invited_emails. (7) PUT /api/templates/{id} updates all fields. (8) POST /api/templates/{id}/create-meeting with generate_series=true creates anchor + series meetings (_series_generated in response). (9) Frontend: SurveysPage has toggle-archived-surveys, archived-surveys-list, restore-{id}, archive-{id} buttons, survey-expires-input. (10) Frontend: MeetingCreatePage has custom-schedule-editor, add-schedule-slot, schedule-slot-{n}, slot-{n}-wd-{weekday}, slot-{n}-start/end, schedule-weeks-input, template-series-{id} labels. Regression: All iteration 78 features (pagination, filters, force-logout, SMTP, DNS) still work.
